message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; the code proceeds directly from loading to featurization without any validation step.

No detected untrusted source handling: Pre-trained BERT models are fetched from HuggingFace Hub using unpinned model names ('bert-base-uncased') with no checksum verification, pinned commit/revision, or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no use of tools like Cleanlab anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code applies StandardScaler for normalization but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples to defend against data poisoning.
No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded via pickle.load, load_model, and BertModel.from_pretrained without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses class_weight.compute_class_weight to handle imbalance but never explicitly validates or checks the label distribution or expected label set before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation enforcement of the test set from training (the scaler is fit on training data but test data flows through the same pipeline without strict separation guarantees), no signed/hashed evaluation data, and only a single set of metrics is reported with no independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data via the generic `load()` function and passes it directly to models without any shape, range, schema, or malformed-input checks.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (predictions) are written directly to file or returned without any probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or threshold checks anywhere in the visible inference code.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although BERT and BiLSTM consume text, they are classification models (not generative LLMs), and there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, or jailbreak detection anywhere in the code.
